summary: Phase 81 Work Order end-to-end backend + frontend testing completed successfully. Backend pytest suite (16 tests) covers CRUD, auto-compute correctness (₹6,87,150 / ₹20,614.50 PBG@3%), value override, expired/cancelled effective status, status filter surfacing inactive WOs, financials dashboard aggregation + grand total consistency, batch-targets Phase 81 enrichment (work_order_value + center_wo_value), and RBAC (partner is 403 on both /api/work-orders and /api/batch-management/financials, admin-only delete). Frontend smoke on /batch-management confirmed dashboard cards wo-card-total-value/pbg/allocated/avg render dynamic ₹ values (₹6,87,150 / ₹20,615 / ₹2,479 / ₹6,87,150), Work Order Financial Summary table + wo-summary-grand row present, filters (wo-filter-search/project/center/fy/status/clear) render, + Work Order (wo-add-btn) opens wo-form-modal, view (wo-summary-view-0) opens wo-detail with wo-print-btn / wo-edit-btn / wo-delete-btn, Target Allocation Stage 1 now has Work Order Value column (bm-tgt-wo-value-*) and eye view action (bm-tgt-view-wo-*) — showing '—' when project/centre/FY doesn't match any WO (correct). Existing Batch Management KPI strip (Targets/Total Target/Allocated/Remaining/Utilization/Total Batches/Active Batches = 1/300/0/300/0%/353/206) all still render.

issues: Radix DialogContent 'Missing Description or aria-describedby' console warning — pre-existing across the app; a11y-only, does not affect functionality

action_items: (Optional) Add a DialogDescription (or VisuallyHidden) to WorkOrderFormModal and WorkOrderViewModal DialogContent to silence the Radix a11y console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: _compute_work_order is backend-authoritative — client-sent derived totals are ignored. Good design (single source of truth).

Override logic: value_override coerces '', 0, '0', None to None (falls back to computed). Numeric override > 0 overrides; PBG recomputes on override. Verified via test_value_override_takes_precedence.
_wo_effective_status correctly derives expired from expiry_date < today.isoformat() and cancelled from status field. Verified.
GET /api/batch-management/financials only counts effective_status=='active' in cards/summary (no double-count of expired/cancelled). Grand total equals sum(row.total_wo_value) — consistency verified.
GET /api/work-orders and /api/work-orders/{id} enforce center_manager scoping via _wo_center_filter and per-doc assigned_center_ids check (403 on foreign centre) — code path present.
DELETE gated to admin-only via require_role('admin'). Correct.
list_batch_targets enriches every row with work_order_value + center_wo_value from db.work_orders (Σ active WOs matching project+centre+fy and per-centre). Verified in test.
Minor: server.py at 22,891 lines exceeds 700-line guideline — long-standing, out of scope for this phase.
